# [ShadowClaw Light Meter Workbench](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-light-meter/)

> Hardware workbench documentation for a TinyDuino, BLE112, and KY-018 photoresistor, with calibrated relative-reading interpretation powered by ShadowClaw. It does not provide device firmware or claim lux accuracy.

## Docs

- [README](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-light-meter/README.md): Project overview and local development
- [AGENTS.md](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-light-meter/AGENTS.md): Conventions for AI agents working on the workbench
